name: aigui
description: Draw charts, diagrams, maths, 3D scenes, topologies, orbits, molecules and dashboards from Codex — as PNGs or a live page in the browser — and get guidance for integrating the @ai-gui SDK.

interface.shortDescription: Charts, diagrams, 3D and topologies, drawn by the agent
interface.longDescription: An MCP server that draws AIGUI blocks — charts, mermaid, maths, 3D scenes, topologies with playable steps, orbits, molecules, data walls — as PNGs the agent can check, or as a live page in your browser; plus skills for when a picture beats text and for integrating the @ai-gui SDK.
